requirements.summary: Add animated agricultural and horticultural visual elements to the HomePage hero section with CSS/Tailwind keyframe animations such as swaying wheat stalks, floating leaves, growing plants, or soil particle effects
acceptanceCriteria: Hero section on HomePage displays at least two distinct animated agricultural/horticultural elements (e.g., swaying crops, floating leaves).
Animations loop smoothly without jank or layout shift.
Animations are styled consistently with the existing green/earth-tone design system.

file_operations.description: Enhance the hero section with at least two animated agricultural/horticultural elements using the custom keyframe animations defined in REQ-4. Add SVG or CSS-based elements representing swaying wheat stalks, floating leaves, growing plants, or soil particles. Position these as overlays or background decorations within the hero container. Wire in the generated images frontend/public/assets/generated/agro-strip-banner.dim_1200x200.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/seedling-sprout.dim_256x256.png as part of the animated decorations. Apply animation classes like 'animate-sway', 'animate-float-up', or 'animate-grow-in' to achieve smooth looping effects. Ensure animations do not cause layout shift and blend with the existing green/earth-tone design tokens.

requirements.summary: Add subtle animated decorative elements with an agricultural theme to the ProductCatalogPage and BusinessProfilePage to reinforce the agro-horticulture brand identity
acceptanceCriteria: ProductCatalogPage has at least one animated agricultural decorative element visible on load.
BusinessProfilePage has at least one animated horticultural decorative element (e.g., animated leaf border or growing vine accent).
Decorative animations do not obscure content or interfere with interactive elements.

file_operations.description: Add at least one animated agricultural decorative element to the ProductCatalogPage, such as animated leaf dividers, sprouting plant borders, or drifting pollen particles. Use the generated image frontend/public/assets/generated/leaf-cluster-icon.dim_128x128.png as a decorative accent. Apply custom animation classes from REQ-4 (e.g., 'animate-leaf-drift' or 'animate-float-up'). Position the animated element so it does not obscure product cards, filters, or other interactive content. Ensure the animation reinforces the agro-horticulture brand without interfering with user interactions.

Add at least one animated horticultural decorative element to the BusinessProfilePage, such as an animated leaf border, growing vine accent, or drifting leaf particles. Incorporate the generated image frontend/public/assets/generated/leaf-cluster-icon.dim_128x128.png or frontend/public/assets/generated/seedling-sprout.dim_256x256.png as part of the decoration. Apply custom animation classes from REQ-4 (e.g., 'animate-grow-in' or 'animate-sway'). Position the animated element tastefully around the profile content without obscuring text, badges, or contact information. Ensure the animation complements the existing layout and design system.

requirements.summary: Enhance the Footer with a subtle animated agricultural/horticultural accent such as a scrolling field row illustration, animated seedling icons, or a gently waving grass/crop strip
acceptanceCriteria: Footer includes at least one animated agricultural visual accent.
Animation is tasteful and does not distract from footer navigation links and contact information.

file_operations.description: Add a subtle animated agricultural/horticultural accent to the Footer. Use the generated image frontend/public/assets/generated/agro-strip-banner.dim_1200x200.png as a scrolling field row illustration or waving grass/crop strip at the top or bottom edge of the footer. Alternatively, add animated seedling icons using frontend/public/assets/generated/seedling-sprout.dim_256x256.png with a growing or swaying animation. Apply custom keyframe animations from REQ-4 (e.g., 'animate-sway' or a horizontal scroll effect). Ensure the animation is tasteful, does not distract from footer navigation links and contact details, and blends harmoniously with the existing footer layout and color scheme.

requirements.summary: Define reusable Tailwind CSS keyframe animations in the Tailwind config to support all agricultural and horticultural animation effects across the site
acceptanceCriteria: tailwind.config.js includes at least three new custom keyframe animation entries relevant to agricultural/horticultural motion.
New animation utility classes are used by the animated components in REQ-1, REQ-2, and REQ-3.

file_operations.description: Define at least three reusable custom keyframe animations in the Tailwind config relevant to agricultural and horticultural motion. Add keyframes such as 'sway' (gentle side-to-side motion for crops or grass), 'float-up' (vertical drift for leaves or pollen), 'leaf-drift' (diagonal floating motion), and 'grow-in' (scale and opacity animation for sprouting plants). Extend the theme.animation and theme.keyframes sections with these new entries, ensuring consistent timing (e.g., 2s–6s durations) and easing (e.g., ease-in-out or cubic-bezier curves). These animations will be consumed by the components modified in REQ-1, REQ-2, and REQ-3 via utility classes like 'animate-sway', 'animate-float-up', 'animate-leaf-drift', and 'animate-grow-in'.
